response.sql: WITH source_metrics AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS funding_source, AVG((s.boxy - s.boxx) / NULLIF(s.boxx, 0)) AS avg_y_vs_x_difference, SUM(s.aream2) / NULLIF(SUM(s.volm3), 0) AS area_to_volume FROM projects AS p JOIN scanspatial AS s ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry WHERE p.fundflux IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.fundflux), cross_source AS (SELECT AVG(area_to_volume) AS avg_area_to_volume FROM source_metrics) SELECT m.funding_source, m.avg_y_vs_x_difference, m.area_to_volume, m.area_to_volume - c.avg_area_to_volume AS above_average FROM source_metrics AS m CROSS JOIN cross_source AS c WHERE m.area_to_volume > c.avg_area_to_volume;
